distantsunrises.setting.enabled.tooltip: Toggle Distant Sunrises level-of-detail terrain rendering.
distantsunrises.setting.render_distance_: Maximum distance in chunks at which Distant Sunrises renders simplified terrain.
distantsunrises.setting.horizontal_quali: Controls how quickly distant terrain transitions to coarser detail levels.
distantsunrises.setting.vertical_quality: Maximum stacked vertical layers kept per column for caves, overhangs, arches and Nether caverns.
distantsunrises.setting.distant_generati: Sample terrain beyond loaded chunks using the world generator.
Worldgen detail level for distant ungenerated chunks (Surface, Carvers, Features or Full Light).
distantsunrises.setting.cave_culling_ena: Skip hidden underground cave layers below the cave culling height in sunlit dimensions.
distantsunrises.setting.cave_culling_hei: Y level below which hidden underground caves are culled from distant terrain.
distantsunrises.setting.fog_enabled.tool: Blend distant terrain smoothly into the horizon sky fog.
distantsunrises.setting.noise_enabled.to: Add subtle per-block luminance variation to untextured distant terrain.
Strength of surface texture variation on distant terrain.
distantsunrises.setting.overdraw_prevent: Fraction of vanilla render distance kept clear before starting LOD transition.
distantsunrises.setting.fade_enabled.too: Dither-fade LOD terrain smoothly across the vanilla render distance boundary.
Shade distant terrain faces by direction and height.
distantsunrises.setting.brightness_multi: Scales distant terrain brightness relative to vanilla lighting.
distantsunrises.setting.ssao_enabled.too: Apply screen-space ambient occlusion to distant LOD terrain valleys and overhangs.
distantsunrises.setting.ssao_quality.too: Sample count for distant screen-space ambient occlusion.
distantsunrises.setting.ssao_strength.to: Intensity of distant ambient occlusion shading.
distantsunrises.setting.disable_vanilla_: Extend vanilla atmospheric render-distance fog so Distant Sunrises handles horizon fog without double-fogging.
distantsunrises.setting.fog_falloff.tool: Distance falloff curve for Distant Sunrises atmospheric fog.
distantsunrises.setting.fog_spherical.to: Use 3D spherical camera distance instead of horizontal cylindrical distance for distant fog.
distantsunrises.setting.height_fog_enabl: Blend atmospheric valley mist relative to the height fog base altitude.
distantsunrises.setting.height_fog_base_: World Y altitude below which valley height fog thickens.
distantsunrises.setting.height_fog_mix_m: How distance fog and height fog combine.
distantsunrises.setting.sharpening_amoun: Contrast-adaptive sharpening strength applied to distant LOD terrain.
distantsunrises.setting.debug_mode.toolt: Diagnostic visualization mode for LOD detail levels, generation provenance, lighting, or cell wireframes.
distantsunrises.command.radius_set: Distant Sunrises render distance set to %s chunks.
distantsunrises.command.cleared: Cleared %s cached Distant Sunrises sections in the active dimension.
distantsunrises.command.remeshed: Queued %s Distant Sunrises sections for re-meshing.
distantsunrises.command.status_line: Distant Sunrises [%s] dim=%s radius=%sch sections=%s slots=%s resident=%s (last prepared frame) weather=%s
distantsunrises.command.debug_set: Distant Sunrises debug mode set to %s.
distantsunrises.setting.thread_preset.to: How much of the CPU Distant Sunrises may use for LOD generation and ingest (10% / 25% / 50% / 75% / 100% of logical processors).
distantsunrises.setting.thread_preset.i_: I Paid For The Whole CPU (100%)
distantsunrises.command.threads_set: Distant Sunrises thread preset set to %s.
